description: This file defines the FindServices class, which provides a set of utility methods for constructing and executing dynamic entity query conditions, mainly used for search operations within the OFBiz framework. It handles preparing search fields, creating entity conditions based on user input, and performing generic find operations with support for pagination and dynamic query building.

classes.name: FindServices
classes.description: A utility class providing methods for dynamically constructing and executing entity queries based on user input, including preparing search fields, creating conditions, and performing search operations with pagination support within the OFBiz framework.

methods.name: prepareField
methods.description: Analyzes inputFields to produce normalized fields with associated operators, parsing parameter names with suffixes to determine their role in query conditions.

methods.name: createConditionList
methods.description: Creates a list of EntityCondition objects based on provided parameters, supporting grouped conditions with logical operators.

methods.name: createSingleCondition
methods.description: Constructs a single EntityCondition based on a model field, operation, value, and context, handling various operators and string operations.

methods.name: createCondition
methods.description: Generates a list of EntityConditions from normalized fields for a given entity model, accommodating range and comparison operators.

methods.name: performFindList
methods.description: Performs a paginated search, returning a list of results and total size based on query conditions and pagination parameters.

methods.name: performFind
methods.description: Executes a generic find query returning iterator and count of matching entities.

methods.name: prepareFind
methods.description: Prepares query conditions and parameters for a find operation based on user input, including handling date filters and default conditions.

methods.name: executeFind
methods.description: Runs the constructed query and returns an iterator over the result set along with total count.

methods.name: buildReducedQueryString
methods.description: Simplifies input fields into a minimal query string suitable for URL encoding, based on the entity model.

methods.name: performFindItem
methods.description: Performs a find query returning the first matched entity instance.

methods.name: dayStart
methods.description: Calculates the start of the day from a timestamp string, considering days offset, timezone, and locale.
